newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks ease slightly by lunch in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks ease slightly by lunch in thin trade.

text.p: Thai stocks dropped slightly in lacklustre trade by the lunch break on Thursday following several bouts of profit-taking, brokers said.
Players were also sidelined ahead of the release of leading monthly economic data by the central bank later on Thursday.

"The market was actionless during the morning session as investors stayed on the sidelines. Many investors believe that there's still a high risk on investment in the market and they opt to holding cash," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.
The composite SET index shed 0.40 point to 689.39 on thin 676 million baht turnover by the break.
Brokers said investors believed that the market was on a downward trend and it was useless to enter the market now.
They said the market might see more action after the key economic figures were released.
The banking sector was first-ranked in terms of value by lunch, falling 0.08 percent, followed by the commerce sector rising 0.45 percent and the communication sector advancing 0.72 percent.
Siam Makro topped the active list, rising one baht to 69.50 by lunch. Bangkok Bank shed two to 184.
